# ShellX vendor provenance: Tauri updater 2.10.1

This directory contains the runtime source of the crates.io package
`tauri-plugin-updater` version `2.10.1`. The upstream crate archive has SHA-256
`806d9dac662c2e4594ff03c647a552f2c9bd544e7d0f683ec58f872f952ce4af`,
the checksum recorded for that package in the original ShellX Cargo lockfile.
The copied Rust source, build script, global API script, permission files, README,
and licenses are unchanged from that archive. Test and package-authoring files
are omitted because they are not inputs to the shipped runtime.

The permission command descriptors, reference and schema match both the
published crate and the files generated by Tauri's plugin build step. They are
retained so a frozen application build leaves this dependency source unchanged.

The only upstream file changed is `Cargo.toml`: the optional Windows `zip`
dependency requires `9.0.5` instead of major version `4`. Its existing
`default-features = false` and the updater's default `zip` feature remain.
Updater source code, signature verification, installation, extraction calls,
and archive selection are unchanged. The direct session-archive writer also
requires ZIP 9, so the application resolves one ZIP major version.

Tauri's maintained updater 2.14.1 independently made the same ZIP major
transition. Its [changelog](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace/blob/v2/plugins/updater/CHANGELOG.md)
records that change, and its [published manifest](https://docs.rs/crate/tauri-plugin-updater/2.14.1/source/Cargo.toml)
requires ZIP 9 on Windows. This narrow backport retains ShellX's existing
Tauri 2.11 and patched Wry runtime until their Browser integration can be
updated together.
